item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. A southwesterly airstream will continue to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong for the rest of this week. The area of low pressure now over the western North Pacific will move towards the seas east of the Philippines in the latter part of this week. It may move across Luzon and enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea early next week, bringing unsettled weather to the region early to midweek next week. However, its development and movement remain uncertain.
